comments.author: home
comments.text:
Findings from 2026-09-26, while adding features/data/generated.feature:
1. `test/conformance/world.ts` defines ConformanceWorld but never calls `setWorldConstructor(ConformanceWorld)`, and `cucumber.mjs` `require` doesn't load world.ts. So every scenario's Before hook crashes (`this.remembered` is undefined).
2. With both fixed locally, against `apricity serve` on a fresh empty library, auth.feature plus crud.feature give **16 of 18 scenarios failing**. Creates return "Unknown error" and unauthorized cases don't return errorType Unauthorized. So TARGET=local isn't working yet.
3. The CLI can't restrict `--paths`, because config paths merge in. A small config that spreads the base and overrides `paths` works.
The generated-samples feature relies on the step-vocabulary check until this runner works.
